text: {"reasoning": "To determine which sales channel accounted for the revenue increase in North America from October to November 2026, I need to: 1) Filter for NA region, 2) Filter for October and November 2026, 3) Group by channel and month, 4) Calculate gross revenue per channel per month, 5) Compare month-over-month changes by channel to see which channel drove the increase.", "query": {"measures": ["Commerce.grossRevenue", "Commerce.orderCount"], "dimensions": ["Commerce.channel"], "time_dimensions": [{"dimension": "Commerce.orderedAt", "granularity": "month", "date_range": ["2026-10-01", "2026-11-30"]}], "filters": [{"member": "Commerce.region", "operator": "equals", "values": ["NA"]}]}}
